boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Run each Git command as a separate statement, capture LASTEXITCODE, and assemble the receipt only after every probe returns.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not place command invocation and LASTEXITCODE capture inside the same parenthesized assignment.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the failed wrapper zero credit and rerun only the read-only probes as independent statements.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only PowerShell orchestration only; no repository or remote state is changed.
preferred_methods.title: Split PowerShell Git proof from exit-code assembly
trigger_preconditions: Several Git ancestry probes must be combined into one sanitized receipt on Windows PowerShell.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect the exact serialized keys, bind the declared field, and preserve the source receipt unchanged.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer receipt property names from prose when the committed schema is available.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the null result and give it no version evidence credit.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Schema-binding recovery only; it performs no application update.
preferred_methods.title: Inspect serialized receipt schema before property binding
trigger_preconditions: A current phase reads a structured receipt produced by an earlier phase or builder.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read the runner-produced state after witness ingestion and request only the remaining validated-to-preferred transition.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Treat runner state transitions as authoritative; never replay an already-applied transition.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed builder run, delete no witness, and rebuild the uncommitted ledger from its declared inputs.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Method Flow orchestration only; no scientific or authority gate is affected.
preferred_methods.title: Respect Method Flow automatic witness promotion
trigger_preconditions: A method is recorded as candidate and the family runner ingests a bounded passing witness.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Build the current intended surface from cached, unstaged, and untracked path sets before comparing coverage.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer the staged surface from git diff without --cached after index mutation.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed suite, leave staged blobs unchanged, and rerun only after the coverage-domain fix is staged.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Git path-set accounting only; it does not change artifact contents or outcome claims.
preferred_methods.title: Union cached unstaged and untracked paths for staged coverage
trigger_preconditions: An exact staged manifest is validated after git add while the worktree itself has no remaining unstaged paths.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Classify only the exact scanner implementation and exact privacy receipt as scanner-definition surfaces.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never exempt a directory, wildcard, unrelated receipt, or arbitrary generated output from privacy adjudication.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed scan and keep the x1 commit blocked until zero non-definition candidates remain.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Exact scanner metadata only; zero confirmed hits is not complete privacy assurance.
preferred_methods.title: Exact self-referential privacy receipt disposition
trigger_preconditions: A privacy receipt is a declared self-exclusion and already exists from a prior uncommitted builder run.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Probe file existence and byte length first, then run syntax and status checks independently.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not place content-wide line counting, status, and syntax checks in one short wrapper.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the timed-out wrapper zero credit and retain the unmodified worktree.
preferred_methods.title: Split large-file inspection into bounded metadata and syntax probes
trigger_preconditions: New or generated implementation files must be inspected on a latency-variable Windows worktree.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Assign the foreach result to an array and pipe that array in a separate statement.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell 5.1 foreach statement.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure with zero credit; no repository state requires rollback.
preferred_methods.title: Assign PowerShell foreach output before piping
trigger_preconditions: A Windows PowerShell 5.1 probe must format or filter rows produced by foreach.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use a longer bounded native exact-pattern search on only the known file.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Treat measured Windows worktree latency, not apparent file size, as the timeout input.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the timed-out search zero credit and retain the unchanged worktree.
preferred_methods.title: Escalate a timed exact-file search to a bounded native probe
trigger_preconditions: A known exact file and exact pattern set must be inspected after a short search timeout.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Load the exact frozen runner names and union them with the fixed builder, runtime, test, and owner-packet paths.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never substitute a guessed naming prefix for an available frozen filename ledger.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the rejected preflight zero evidence credit and stage nothing until the exact-name check passes.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Owner-scoped path accounting only; no broad script-directory exemption is allowed.
preferred_methods.title: Derive staged runner scope from the frozen runner-name ledger
trigger_preconditions: A phase generates runner files from an X1-frozen runner-name ledger.
